description: Approve a reviewed kit at expected_kit_revision with the user's go-ahead; an agent approval is recorded as decided_by=agent. Approval starts the article write as a new job on the item and charges no further allowance (the held generation already paid for one write): poll it with list_jobs content_item_id, not the held job. write=started means the write is running (also after an earlier approval); write=not_started stores the approval without a write, so approve again or regenerate. A held generation buys one write; approving again never starts a second. 409 item_not_generatable stores nothing. Never send Idempotency-Key.

body.description: Approve or reject the kit at this revision (request).
